architecture: Task -> Node Orchestrator (:8392/:9119) -> Local File/Task Watcher Hook -> Node PR Branch (alienware/*) -> GitHub Webhook -> Reviewers (Gemini / Jules / Claude / Codex in GitHub) Validate -> Merge by Josh or the signed-in Claude judge lane -> Obsidian + Dashboard Sync

stages.name: 1. Task / File Change Hook (Alienware Node)
stages.detail: fs.watch + Kanban trigger detects edits or new tasks immediately

stages.name: 2. Default Orchestrator (:9119 / agy)
stages.detail: Routes to Harvey, YouTube, Editor, Kanban, FCC (:8082), or Notes profile

stages.name: 3. Local TDD + Screenshot Proof
stages.detail: Runs node --test + publishes visual proof to Media Preview Pane

stages.name: 4. Node Branch PR + GitHub Webhook
stages.detail: Pushes node-scoped PR payload to Trollz1004/ANTIGRAVITY

stages.name: 5. Reviewers Validate (Jules / Claude / Codex / Gemini), Josh or the Claude Judge Lane Merges
stages.detail: Reviewer lanes comment after CI passes; only Josh or the signed-in Claude judge lane merges — zero unjudged node merges

stages.name: 6. Obsidian + T5500 ai-memory (:49374) + Graphy Sync
stages.detail: Appends timestamped node entry to Alienware/gemini-to-gemini.md & hermes-to-hermes.md

events.summary: Initialized circular Task -> Node OPSis Orchestrator -> GitHub PR -> Review -> Merge by Josh or the Claude judge lane loop on Alienware.

lastPushPr.summary: Initialized circular Task -> Node OPSis Orchestrator -> GitHub PR -> Review -> Merge by Josh or the Claude judge lane loop on Alienware.
